title: Project
description: A project, activity, goal, or system tracked in d-system. last_touched is deliberately absent: it is derived at rebuild from the latest activity across the project's interactions, commitments, tasks and decisions, and a hand-maintained activity date is a number that drifts. additionalProperties is false, so a _data/ file carrying it is rejected.

type.description: project=scoped+bounded | activity=ongoing habit | goal=aspirational target | system=framework being built | certification=credentialing path

last_reviewed.description: When the owner deliberately sat down and assessed this project. Hand-set, and distinct from the derived last_touched, which only says activity happened. Both questions are worth answering; do not collapse them.

review_cadence.description: Policy the owner sets: how often this project should be touched. The threshold staleness is measured against — a project is stale when today minus the derived last_touched exceeds this rhythm. 'ongoing' is retired: it described activity status, which project.status already carries, and gave the staleness check nothing to compute against. ad-hoc declares no rhythm, so the project never becomes stale on a schedule.

repository.description: Where this project's own code or content actually lives, when it is not this repository — a local path or a remote URL. d-system tracks that a project exists; this field is how it says where the project went, instead of a free-text note that drifts.
